headline: Aselsan order backlog reaches $30.7 billion on strong defense demand
summary: Turkish defense and electronics giant Aselsan reported its order backlog grew to $30.7 billion at the end of the last quarter.
why: An expanding order backlog provides high revenue visibility for major defense contractors, supporting medium-term operational growth.

impacts.name: Aselsan
impacts.why: A record order backlog signals strong future revenue generation from air defense and electronics contracts.
